name: sol_basics_vi_svi_14
description: ABIDecoderV2 memory-corruption bug: abi.decode of multi-dimensional arrays/structs from memory in vulnerable Solidity versions
question: The source file in `source` declares a pragma solidity version within the vulnerable ABIDecoderV2 range (0.4.16 to 0.8.3, or leaves the version unpinned/floating so it can compile with one of these) and calls abi.decode on a memory byte array to produce a multi-dimensional array or a struct value, without upgrading to or pinning a patched compiler version (>=0.8.4) or otherwise avoiding decoding such nested memory types, so decoded results can be corrupted by memory contents outside the actual encoded array.
criteria: A function uses abi.decode(data, (uint256[][])) or similar nested/multi-dimensional array type on a memory bytes/byte array parameter
A function uses abi.decode(data, (SomeStruct)) or (SomeStruct[]) where SomeStruct contains dynamic members, decoding from a memory byte array
A low-level call's returned memory bytes are decoded via abi.decode into a struct or multi-dimensional array type
A function accepts bytes calldata/memory input, copies or receives it in memory, and decodes it with abi.decode into a struct containing a dynamic array field
